task.prompt:
An application form gives an applicant name and an entity type, and quotes a PAN (get_input). Use the PAN structure rule in get_policy. Give: pan_matches_name = true only if the PAN fits the entity type and the name, otherwise false; reason = exactly one of ok (it fits), holder_type_mismatch (the 4th character does not match the entity type) or surname_initial_mismatch (the 4th character fits but the 5th character does not match the first letter of the surname, or of the entity name for a non-individual). If both are wrong, give holder_type_mismatch.

Answer fields: pan_matches_name, reason.

world.document_text:
APPLICATION
Applicant name: Vikram Banerjee
Entity type: Individual
PAN quoted: GVZPV8676K
